name: Kofemania
tagline: Waffles, cocoa and coffee for the whole family

listing.description: A site for a family café, waffle house or kids-friendly coffee shop. Bright stickers, a spinning plate on the first screen, a card menu and a delivery tracker.

seo.title: Kofemania — family coffee shop with waffles in Yunusabad
seo.description: Belgian waffles, cocoa, coffee and a kids’ corner at 12 Bogishamol St. Kids’ parties at weekends and waffle delivery across Yunusabad from 8 am to 10 pm.
seo.answer: Kofemania is a family coffee shop at 12 Bogishamol St in Yunusabad, open daily from 8 am to 10 pm. A Belgian waffle costs from 32,000 UZS, cocoa 24,000 UZS and a cappuccino 25,000 UZS. There is a kids’ corner, weekend parties and delivery across Yunusabad.

sections.title: Grown-up waffles, kid-style cocoa
sections.subtitle: Crisp Belgian waffles from fresh dough, hot cocoa with marshmallows and proper coffee for the parents. While the grown-ups talk, the kids draw in our corner.

items.name: Mini waffles
items.text: Five with honey, a toddler portion

sections.label: About
sections.title: A café you can walk into with a pram
sections.text: Kofemania was started by two parents tired of choosing between good coffee and a place where a child is not bored. We have a wide step-free entrance, a changing table, high chairs and a corner with building blocks and colouring books. Waffle batter is made fresh every morning.

items.title: Order
items.text: Tap “Order waffles” and list what you want.

items.title: We bake
items.text: We bake after your call, not in advance, so it stays crisp.

items.title: Packing
items.text: Toppings in a separate cup, the waffle in a vented box.

items.quote: While I drink my halva latte, my son builds a castle in the corner. Best forty minutes of my week.
items.author: Dilnoza

items.quote: We had our daughter’s sixth birthday here: an entertainer, waffles with candles, nobody cried.
items.author: Rustam

items.quote: The waffle arrived crisp. I didn’t think delivery could do that.
items.author: Aziz

items.q: Can we hold a kids’ party?
items.a: Yes, on Saturdays and Sundays. Room for 15 children, an entertainer and waffles with candles from 1,200,000 UZS.
We have rice-flour waffles; tell us when ordering and we bake them in a separate iron.
Yes, in the ground-floor restroom, with step-free access.
Across Yunusabad from 8 am to 9:30 pm, minimum order 50,000 UZS.

sections.label: Contact
sections.title: Come with the whole family
sections.text: 12 Bogishamol St, Yunusabad, next to the park. Every day 8 am to 10 pm. Want waffles at home? Leave an order and we will call back.
